body:
Difficult Journey
Not the greatest setting but, it seemed super weak and multiple attempts left me with nothing, I truly didn't expect any effect.
Now, backtracking, I cooked for 5 hrs the 6' approximately but only drank half, as I had to throw up the last bit. I decided to wait, and time really slowed down... I began feeling overwhelmed with nervousness, every time I close my eyes I see dark and twisted things. Sometimes it seems as if I'm seeing the genetic code of .... idk cactus, but no, more like a living jungle in its most primal spectrum.
I can't express enough how worried I am, I'm writing this at the tail end, yet still influenced. I decided to take pictures to see if the darkness would come thru and OMG!! My images look like I'm battered, deep black circles under my eyes that don't exist, seriously I went to the bathroom to double check. Worried I sent one image to my brother to see if he saw the same... He immediately asked what the hell was wrong with my eyes.  So whoa... whatever dark I'm seeing in my visions is actually showing up with my camera.
This is pretty much all I'm going to write as I'm kinda freaked out at the moment. I was very worried about the authenticity of that cactus beforehand but couldn't find any info on it to verify. Drinking it had no bitterness at all which should have meant zero potency. Well, I'm floored.
